items.statement: Higher-performing sites allow nurses to start antibiotics and stock them near triage, while lower-performing sites depend on physician orders, especially at night.
items.rationale: Consistent with the retrieved multi-site study and review; directly actionable.
items.risks: Local determinants may differ, for example pharmacy policy.

items.statement: Crowding and night staffing explain more of the difference between sites than knowledge of the bundle.
items.rationale: Staff knowledge was similar across sites in the retrieved study.
items.risks: Staff may attribute delays to crowding when other factors matter.

items.statement: Sites with regular feedback of time-to-antibiotic figures sustain their performance.
items.rationale: Feedback is a consistent facilitator in the review.

summary: Three working propositions to explore, not test; h1 leads.
